Definition: remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)
BiblicalUsage: adj; 1) remote, far, distant, distant lands, distant ones; 1a) of distance, time; n m; 2) distance; 2a) from a distance (with prep)
